get.description: Sent and received messages across your whole account, newest first, with delivery status on each. Filter by device, direction, status, text, and time range. Two pagination modes: page numbers for browsing, or cursor for polling. To poll for new messages: request order=asc with a from timestamp, follow nextCursor until hasMore is false, then resume from the last nextCursor on the next poll. Time filters apply to createdAt (when the platform stored the message). For received messages this is upload time, which can lag receivedAt if the device was offline. A received message uploaded more than 24 hours after receivedAt is stored with createdAt set to receivedAt and the upload time in originalCreatedAt, so a poll that has already moved past receivedAt does not return it.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque position from a previous response nextCursor. Returns the page after that position and switches meta to nextCursor/hasMore without a total count.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Messages per page. Default 50, maximum 100.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page to return. Default 1. Mutually exclusive with cursor.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: desc (default) for newest first; asc to walk forward in time when polling.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on createdAt, same formats as from. Exclusive so consecutive windows never double-count a boundary message.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on createdAt, which for a received message uploaded more than 24 hours late equals receivedAt. ISO-8601 with an explicit timezone (2026-08-01T00:00:00Z or +03:00 form), or a date (2026-08-01, read as UTC midnight). A datetime without a timezone is rejected.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Match against the message text and the other party number. Encrypted messages cannot be searched.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Delivery state to return. Combine with direction: direction=sent&status=failed lists sends that failed.

parameters.name: smsBatchId
parameters.description: Only messages from this batch, using the smsBatchId returned by a send. Combine with status=failed to list the recipients of a batch that failed.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Deprecated alias of direction. Still works; prefer direction.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Direction to return. Default all. Matches the lowercase direction field on each message. Not the same as status: direction=sent means outbound, status=sent means the device dispatched it.

parameters.name: deviceIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated device ids to include, from GET /gateway/devices. Default: all devices on the account. Messages from deleted devices are never included.

400.description: Invalid deviceIds, smsBatchId, direction, status, from, to, order, or cursor value. Unknown filter values fail rather than silently applying no filter.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or revoked API key.

404.description: A deviceIds entry or the smsBatchId is not on your account.

info.title: textbee API
info.description: Send and receive SMS through an Android phone you own. Authenticate every request with an API key from your textbee dashboard, sent as the x-api-key header.

tags.name: gateway
tags.description: Send SMS and read message history through the Android devices paired with your account.

tags.name: webhooks
tags.description: Subscribe to SMS events and inspect the delivery attempts textbee made for them.

x-api-key.name: x-api-key
x-api-key.description: API key from your textbee dashboard, sent on every request.

totalSentSMSCount.description: Messages sent across all your devices.

totalReceivedSMSCount.description: Messages received across all your devices.

subscriptionId.description: Android subscription id of the SIM. Pass it as simSubscriptionId when sending to choose this SIM.

cardId.description: Android card id of the SIM slot.

carrierName.description: Mobile network operator, as reported by Android.

displayName.description: Label the user gave this SIM on the device.

countryIso.description: Two letter country code of the SIM.

subscriptionType.description: Whether the SIM is physical or an eSIM.

serviceState.description: Whether the SIM had network service when the device last reported.

simState.description: State of the SIM card itself, as reported by Android.

isRoaming.description: Whether the SIM was roaming when the device last reported.

signalLevel.description: Signal strength on a 0 to 4 scale, where 0 is no signal.

lastUpdated.description: When the device last reported its SIM list.

sims.description: SIMs currently installed in the device.

isCharging.description: Whether the device was charging at the last heartbeat.

maxBytes.description: Maximum memory the app may use, in bytes.

isIgnoringBatteryOptimizations.description: Whether the app is exempt from battery optimization. When false, Android may delay the app in the background.

isDeviceIdleMode.description: Whether the device was in Doze at the last heartbeat.

isPowerSaveMode.description: Whether battery saver was on at the last heartbeat.

_id.description: Device id. Pass it as deviceId when sending.

enabled.description: Whether the device may send and receive SMS. Sending to a disabled device fails.

isDefault.description: Whether sends without a deviceId go out from this device.

name.description: Your own label for the device.

receiveSMSEnabled.description: Whether incoming messages are forwarded to textbee. Required for received message history and webhooks.

deviceUptimeInfo.description: How long the device has been up.

memoryInfo.description: Memory reported at the last heartbeat.

storageInfo.description: Storage reported at the last heartbeat.

systemInfo.description: Timezone and locale of the device.

updatedAt.description: When the device was last updated.

message.description: Text of the message. Long messages are split by the carrier.
message.example: Your appointment is confirmed for Tuesday at 10am.

recipients.description: Phone numbers to send to, in international format. Each recipient is billed as one message.

simSubscriptionId.description: SIM to send from, as subscriptionId from the device simInfo. Defaults to the device default SIM.

scheduledAt.description: ISO 8601 time to send the message. Must be in the future. Omit to send now.

smsBody.description: Legacy alias for message. Used only when message is absent.

receivers.description: Legacy alias for recipients. Used only when recipients is absent.

deviceId.description: Device to send from. When omitted, uses your default device, or the enabled device with the most recent heartbeat.

success.description: Whether the batch was accepted. Queued sends only.

message.description: Human readable outcome. Queued sends only.
message.example: SMS added to queue for processing

successCount.description: Messages pushed to the device. Returned instead of the queue fields when the instance dispatches immediately.

failureCount.description: Messages that could not be pushed to the device.

device.description: Device that sent or received the message.

type.description: Direction of the message, uppercase. Deprecated: read the lowercase direction field instead, whose values match the direction query filter.

status.description: Delivery state, lowercase. Incoming messages are always received. Outgoing messages move from pending to sent, then to delivered when the carrier confirms. Absent on messages stored before status tracking, so treat a missing value as unknown.

sender.description: Sender number. Set on received messages.

recipient.description: Destination number. Set on sent messages.

smsBatch.description: Id of the batch this message was sent in.

encrypted.description: Whether the body is end to end encrypted. Encrypted bodies can only be read by your own client.

receivedAt.description: When the message was received. Received messages only.

requestedAt.description: When the send was requested. Sent messages only.

dispatchDueAt.description: When the queue is due to hand the message to the push service. Set for queued messages that wait server-side before dispatch: scheduled sends, and large sends, which are released in waves paced to the device send delay so the phone is never asked to hold more than it can send. Absent for immediate sends.

dispatchedAt.description: When the push service accepted the message for delivery to the device. Does not mean the device has received it; sentAt is the first device-confirmed timestamp.

dispatchAttempts.description: How many times the message has been handed to the push service. Normally 1; higher when a message was dispatched again.

pushReceivedAt.description: When the device received the push for this message. Absent for messages handled by app versions that do not report it.

sendAttemptedAt.description: When the device handed the message to the radio. The gap to sentAt is time spent in the radio; the gap from pushReceivedAt is time the message waited on the device.

sentAt.description: When the device reported the message as sent.

errorCode.description: Failure code reported by the device.

errorMessage.description: Failure reason reported by the device.

overLimit.description: True when the message was received while the account was over its plan limit. Received messages only. Absent otherwise.

originalCreatedAt.description: When the platform stored the message. Set only on a received message uploaded more than 24 hours after receivedAt, whose createdAt is set to receivedAt.

createdAt.description: When the record was created. For a received message uploaded more than 24 hours after receivedAt, this equals receivedAt and originalCreatedAt holds the upload time.

updatedAt.description: When the record was last updated.

direction.description: Direction of the message, lowercase. Values match the direction query filter, so a response value can be passed straight back as a filter. Not the same thing as status: direction=sent means outbound, status=sent means the device dispatched it.

channel.description: Message channel. Currently always sms; mms will appear here when supported. Absent means sms.

meta.description: Pagination metadata. Page mode (no cursor) returns page, limit, total, totalPages plus nextCursor and hasMore; cursor mode returns limit, nextCursor, and hasMore only, skipping the expensive total count. anyOf rather than oneOf: a page-mode object also satisfies the cursor-mode shape, and oneOf would make strict validators reject it.
